no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened to discuss this application, because of its close similarity to the previously approved products Ceredase and Cerezyme, and because it did not pose unique concerns beyond those applicable to those other drugs in this class of enzyme replacement therapy.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for VPRIV (velaglucerase alfa, BLA022575). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review) uniformly state that an AdComm was not held because the drug is not first in its class, closely resembled previously approved enzyme replacement therapies (Ceredase and Cerezyme) for Type 1 Gaucher disease, and the application raised no significant safety, efficacy, or public-health questions requiring outside expertise. Because no committee was convened, there are no AdComm concern-to-change linkages.
